fields.source: Keep original quality_flags, kind, physical groups, independent/reference 4x4 components and graph SHA. Sampling classes are conditional research-use labels, not stellar identity certification.
fields.region: Look up native J2015.5 position in the NSIDE32 evidence cells and the reference-r layer. Do not silently rescale or subtract QSO zeros from individual sources.
fields.covariance: Original conditional+reference covariance preserved. No learned model passed all identity and spatial transfer gates; no universal faint-stellar scale adopted.
fields.area: Occupied core envelopes overlap between classes and are upper envelopes, not calibrated or pure-star area. NSIDE32 cells are evidence support, not full-cell certification. Geometric opportunity remains separately frozen.
